+bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* block, size_t stride, size_t blockSize,
+                         size_t globalStart, size_t& failedDiagonal) {
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < blockSize; ++j) {
+        double* diagonalRow = block + j * stride;
+        double sum = 0.0;
+        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+            sum += diagonalRow[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+        }
+
+        const double value = diagonalRow[globalStart + j] - sum;
+        if (!(value > 0.0)) {
+            failedDiagonal = globalStart + j;
+            return false;
+        }
+        diagonalRow[globalStart + j] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < blockSize; ++i) {
+            double* row = block + i * stride;
+            double product = 0.0;
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                product += row[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+            }
+            row[globalStart + j] =
+                (row[globalStart + j] - product) / diagonalRow[globalStart + j];
+        }
+    }
+    return true;
+}

+constexpr size_t kPreferredBlockSize = 32;
+constexpr size_t kMinimumBlockSize = 16;
+constexpr int kDistributionTag = 100;
+constexpr int kGatherTag = 101;
+
+// Matrix row blocks are assigned cyclically.  Unlike a contiguous row
+// decomposition this keeps the increasingly expensive lower rows balanced
+// across ranks throughout the factorization.
+struct RowDistribution {
+    size_t n;
+    size_t blockSize;
+    size_t numBlocks;
+    int rank;
+    int ranks;
+
+    RowDistribution(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRank, int mpiRanks)
+        : n(matrixSize),
+          blockSize(selectBlockSize(matrixSize, mpiRanks)),
+          numBlocks((matrixSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize),
+          rank(mpiRank),
+          ranks(mpiRanks) {}
+
+    static size_t selectBlockSize(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRanks) {
+        if (matrixSize == 0) {
+            return 1;
+        }
+
+        const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(mpiRanks, 1));
+        const size_t targetBlocks = rankCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / 4
+                                        ? std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()
+                                        : 4 * rankCount;
+        const size_t desired = (matrixSize + targetBlocks - 1) / targetBlocks;
+        size_t result = std::min(kPreferredBlockSize,
+                                 std::max(kMinimumBlockSize, desired));
+        result = std::min(result, matrixSize);
+
+        // Do not strand ranks merely because the preferred cache block is
+        // larger than the amount of work available per rank.
+        if ((matrixSize + result - 1) / result < rankCount && matrixSize >= rankCount) {
+            result = (matrixSize + rankCount - 1) / rankCount;
+        }
+        return std::max<size_t>(result, 1);
+    }
+
+    size_t firstRow(size_t block) const { return block * blockSize; }
+
+    size_t rowsInBlock(size_t block) const {
+        return std::min(blockSize, n - firstRow(block));
+    }

+bool mpiCountFits(size_t count) {

+// Distribute contiguous row blocks without making every process allocate the
+// root's complete matrix.  Messages from a given source use identical tags;
+// MPI's ordering rule matches them to the receives posted in block order.
+void distributeRowsFromRoot(const std::vector<double>& rootMatrix,
+                            std::vector<double>& localMatrix,
+                            const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
+    requests.reserve(dist.numBlocks);
+
+    if (dist.rank == 0) {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+            const double* source = rootMatrix.data() + dist.firstRow(block) * dist.n;
+            if (dist.owner(block) == 0) {
+                std::copy_n(source, count, dist.block(localMatrix, block));
+            } else {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                MPI_Isend(source, static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE, dist.owner(block),
+                          kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    } else {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            if (dist.owns(block)) {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+                MPI_Irecv(dist.block(localMatrix, block), static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          0, kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (!requests.empty()) {
+        MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+    }
+}

+// Generate exactly the same deterministic B as the sequential implementation,
+// distribute it, then form only the rows of A owned by this rank.  Each row
+// block of B is streamed once to all ranks, so storage is O(n^2/P).
+void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA,
+                                    const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<double> localB(dist.localRows() * dist.n);
+
+    {
+        std::vector<double> rootB;
+        if (dist.rank == 0) {
+            rootB.resize(dist.n * dist.n);
+            unsigned int seed = 42;
+            for (double& value : rootB) {
+                value = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
+            }
+        }
+        distributeRowsFromRoot(rootB, localB, dist);
+    }
+
+    localA.assign(dist.localRows() * dist.n, 0.0);
+    std::vector<double> receivedB(dist.blockSize * dist.n);
+
+    for (size_t sourceBlock = 0; sourceBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++sourceBlock) {
+        const size_t sourceRows = dist.rowsInBlock(sourceBlock);
+        const size_t sourceStart = dist.firstRow(sourceBlock);
+        double* bRows = dist.owns(sourceBlock) ? dist.block(localB, sourceBlock)
+                                               : receivedB.data();
+        MPI_Bcast(bRows, static_cast<int>(sourceRows * dist.n), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  dist.owner(sourceBlock), MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+        for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+            if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+            const double* ownB = dist.block(localB, localBlock);
+            double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+
+            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+                const double* bi = ownB + i * dist.n;
+                double* ai = ownA + i * dist.n;
+                for (size_t j = 0; j < sourceRows; ++j) {
+                    const double* bj = bRows + j * dist.n;
+                    double sum = 0.0;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
+                    for (size_t k = 0; k < dist.n; ++k) {
+                        sum += bi[k] * bj[k];
+                    }
+                    ai[sourceStart + j] = sum;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Add the identity contribution exactly once after all streamed B blocks
+    // have contributed to A = B * B^T.
+    for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+        if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+        const size_t globalStart = dist.firstRow(localBlock);
+        double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+            ownA[i * dist.n + globalStart + i] += static_cast<double>(dist.n);
+        }
+    }
+}

+bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* block, size_t stride, size_t blockSize,
+                         size_t globalStart, size_t& failedDiagonal) {
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < blockSize; ++j) {
+        double* diagonalRow = block + j * stride;
+        double sum = 0.0;
+        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+            sum += diagonalRow[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+        }
+
+        const double value = diagonalRow[globalStart + j] - sum;
+        if (!(value > 0.0)) {
+            failedDiagonal = globalStart + j;
+            return false;
+        }
+        diagonalRow[globalStart + j] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < blockSize; ++i) {
+            double* row = block + i * stride;
+            double product = 0.0;
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                product += row[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+            }
+            row[globalStart + j] =
+                (row[globalStart + j] - product) / diagonalRow[globalStart + j];
+        }
+    }
+    return true;
+}
+
+// Blocked right-looking Cholesky.  A compact panel is all-gathered once per
+// block; its per-tile transposed layout makes each trailing rank-k update walk
+// contiguous memory in its innermost loop.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& localA, const RowDistribution& dist,
+                           size_t& failedDiagonal) {
+    std::vector<double> diagonal(dist.blockSize * dist.blockSize);
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
+    std::vector<int> displacements(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
+    std::vector<size_t> panelOffsets(dist.numBlocks);
+    std::vector<size_t> processOffsets(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
+    std::vector<double> localPanel;
+    std::vector<double> globalPanel;
+
+    for (size_t panelBlock = 0; panelBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++panelBlock) {
+        const size_t panelStart = dist.firstRow(panelBlock);
+        const size_t panelWidth = dist.rowsInBlock(panelBlock);
+        const int diagonalOwner = dist.owner(panelBlock);
+        int success = 1;
+        unsigned long long failed = 0;
+
+        if (dist.rank == diagonalOwner) {
+            size_t localFailure = 0;
+            double* diagonalBlock = dist.block(localA, panelBlock);
+            success = factorDiagonalBlock(diagonalBlock, dist.n, panelWidth,
+                                          panelStart, localFailure)
+                          ? 1
+                          : 0;
+            failed = static_cast<unsigned long long>(localFailure);
+            if (success) {
+                for (size_t i = 0; i < panelWidth; ++i) {
+                    for (size_t j = 0; j < panelWidth; ++j) {
+                        diagonal[i * panelWidth + j] =
+                            j <= i ? diagonalBlock[i * dist.n + panelStart + j] : 0.0;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Bcast(&success, 1, MPI_INT, diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        if (!success) {
+            failedDiagonal = static_cast<size_t>(failed);
+            return false;
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(diagonal.data(), static_cast<int>(panelWidth * panelWidth), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+        // Distributed triangular solve for all blocks below the diagonal.
+        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            if (!dist.owns(block)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(block);
+            double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, block);
+            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+                double* row = matrixBlock + i * dist.n + panelStart;
+                for (size_t j = 0; j < panelWidth; ++j) {
+                    double product = 0.0;
+                    for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                        product += row[k] * diagonal[j * panelWidth + k];
+                    }
+                    row[j] = (row[j] - product) / diagonal[j * panelWidth + j];
                 }
-                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;
-                if (val <= 0.0) {

-                    return false;
+            }
+        }
+
+        std::fill(receiveCounts.begin(), receiveCounts.end(), 0);
+        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(dist.owner(block))] +=
+                static_cast<int>(dist.rowsInBlock(block) * panelWidth);
+        }
+        int totalPanelValues = 0;
+        for (int process = 0; process < dist.ranks; ++process) {
+            displacements[static_cast<size_t>(process)] = totalPanelValues;
+            totalPanelValues += receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(process)];
+        }
+
+        localPanel.resize(
+            static_cast<size_t>(receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(dist.rank)]));
+        size_t packedOffset = 0;
+        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            if (!dist.owns(block)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(block);
+            const double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, block);
+            // Transpose the narrow panel tile while packing it.
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < panelWidth; ++k) {
+                for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+                    localPanel[packedOffset++] = matrixBlock[i * dist.n + panelStart + k];
                 }
-                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);
-            } else {
-                // Off-diagonal element
-                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
-                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];
+            }
+        }
+
+        globalPanel.resize(static_cast<size_t>(totalPanelValues));
+        MPI_Allgatherv(localPanel.data(),
+                       receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(dist.rank)], MPI_DOUBLE,
+                       globalPanel.data(), receiveCounts.data(), displacements.data(),
+                       MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+        for (int process = 0; process < dist.ranks; ++process) {
+            processOffsets[static_cast<size_t>(process)] =
+                static_cast<size_t>(displacements[static_cast<size_t>(process)]);
+        }
+        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            const size_t owner = static_cast<size_t>(dist.owner(block));
+            panelOffsets[block] = processOffsets[owner];
+            processOffsets[owner] += dist.rowsInBlock(block) * panelWidth;
+        }
+
+        // Each rank updates all lower-triangular tiles in its owned block rows.
+        for (size_t rowBlock = panelBlock + 1; rowBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++rowBlock) {
+            if (!dist.owns(rowBlock)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rowCount = dist.rowsInBlock(rowBlock);
+            const size_t rowStart = dist.firstRow(rowBlock);
+            double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, rowBlock);
+            const double* leftPanel = globalPanel.data() + panelOffsets[rowBlock];
+
+            for (size_t columnBlock = panelBlock + 1; columnBlock <= rowBlock;
+                 ++columnBlock) {
+                const size_t columnCount = dist.rowsInBlock(columnBlock);
+                const size_t columnStart = dist.firstRow(columnBlock);
+                const double* rightPanel = globalPanel.data() + panelOffsets[columnBlock];
+
+                if (columnBlock < rowBlock) {
+                    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount; ++i) {
+                        double* result = matrixBlock + i * dist.n + columnStart;
+                        for (size_t k = 0; k < panelWidth; ++k) {
+                            const double multiplier = leftPanel[k * rowCount + i];
+                            const double* rhs = rightPanel + k * columnCount;
+#pragma omp simd
+                            for (size_t j = 0; j < columnCount; ++j) {
+                                result[j] -= multiplier * rhs[j];
+                            }
+                        }
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    // Only the lower half of a diagonal tile is subsequently used.
+                    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount; ++i) {
+                        double* result = matrixBlock + i * dist.n + rowStart;
+                        for (size_t k = 0; k < panelWidth; ++k) {
+                            const double multiplier = leftPanel[k * rowCount + i];
+                            const double* rhs = leftPanel + k * rowCount;
+#pragma omp simd
+                            for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
+                                result[j] -= multiplier * rhs[j];
+                            }
+                        }
+                    }
                 }
-                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];
             }
         }
-        
-        // Zero out upper triangular part
-        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
-            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;
+    }
+
+    // Match the original result representation: L occupies the lower triangle
+    // and every element above it is zero.
+    for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+        if (!dist.owns(block)) {
+            continue;
         }
+        const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(block);
+        const size_t start = dist.firstRow(block);
+        double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, block);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+            double* row = matrixBlock + i * dist.n;
+            std::fill(row + start + i + 1, row + dist.n, 0.0);
+        }
     }
-    
     return true;

-// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)

+constexpr size_t kPreferredBlockSize = 32;
+constexpr size_t kMinimumBlockSize = 16;
+constexpr int kDistributionTag = 100;
+constexpr int kGatherTag = 101;
+
+// Matrix row blocks are assigned cyclically.  Unlike a contiguous row
+// decomposition this keeps the increasingly expensive lower rows balanced
+// across ranks throughout the factorization.
+struct RowDistribution {
+    size_t n;
+    size_t blockSize;
+    size_t numBlocks;
+    int rank;
+    int ranks;
+
+    RowDistribution(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRank, int mpiRanks)
+        : n(matrixSize),
+          blockSize(selectBlockSize(matrixSize, mpiRanks)),
+          numBlocks((matrixSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize),
+          rank(mpiRank),
+          ranks(mpiRanks) {}
+
+    static size_t selectBlockSize(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRanks) {
+        if (matrixSize == 0) {
+            return 1;
+        }
+
+        const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(mpiRanks, 1));
+        const size_t targetBlocks = rankCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / 4
+                                        ? std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()
+                                        : 4 * rankCount;
+        const size_t desired = (matrixSize + targetBlocks - 1) / targetBlocks;
+        size_t result = std::min(kPreferredBlockSize,
+                                 std::max(kMinimumBlockSize, desired));
+        result = std::min(result, matrixSize);
+
+        // Do not strand ranks merely because the preferred cache block is
+        // larger than the amount of work available per rank.
+        if ((matrixSize + result - 1) / result < rankCount && matrixSize >= rankCount) {
+            result = (matrixSize + rankCount - 1) / rankCount;
+        }
+        return std::max<size_t>(result, 1);
+    }
+
+    size_t firstRow(size_t block) const { return block * blockSize; }
+
+    size_t rowsInBlock(size_t block) const {
+        return std::min(blockSize, n - firstRow(block));
+    }

+        return static_cast<int>(block % static_cast<size_t>(ranks));

+    bool owns(size_t block) const { return owner(block) == rank; }

+        return (block / static_cast<size_t>(ranks)) * blockSize;

+             block += static_cast<size_t>(ranks)) {

+    }
+
+    const double* block(const std::vector<double>& matrix, size_t blockIndex) const {
+        return matrix.data() + localRowOffset(blockIndex) * n;
+    }

+bool mpiCountFits(size_t count) {
+    return count <= static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max());

+// Distribute contiguous row blocks without making every process allocate the
+// root's complete matrix.  Messages from a given source use identical tags;
+// MPI's ordering rule matches them to the receives posted in block order.
+void distributeRowsFromRoot(const std::vector<double>& rootMatrix,
+                            std::vector<double>& localMatrix,
+                            const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
+    requests.reserve(dist.numBlocks);
+
+    if (dist.rank == 0) {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+            const double* source = rootMatrix.data() + dist.firstRow(block) * dist.n;
+            if (dist.owner(block) == 0) {
+                std::copy_n(source, count, dist.block(localMatrix, block));
+            } else {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                MPI_Isend(source, static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE, dist.owner(block),
+                          kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    } else {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            if (dist.owns(block)) {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+                MPI_Irecv(dist.block(localMatrix, block), static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          0, kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (!requests.empty()) {
+        MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+    }
+}

+// Generate exactly the same deterministic B as the sequential implementation,
+// distribute it, then form only the rows of A owned by this rank.  Each row
+// block of B is streamed once to all ranks, so storage is O(n^2/P).
+void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA,
+                                    const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<double> localB(dist.localRows() * dist.n);
+
+    {
+        std::vector<double> rootB;
+        if (dist.rank == 0) {
+            rootB.resize(dist.n * dist.n);
+            unsigned int seed = 42;
+            for (double& value : rootB) {
+                value = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
+            }
+        }
+        distributeRowsFromRoot(rootB, localB, dist);
+    }
+
+    localA.assign(dist.localRows() * dist.n, 0.0);
+    std::vector<double> receivedB(dist.blockSize * dist.n);
+
+    for (size_t sourceBlock = 0; sourceBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++sourceBlock) {
+        const size_t sourceRows = dist.rowsInBlock(sourceBlock);
+        const size_t sourceStart = dist.firstRow(sourceBlock);
+        double* bRows = dist.owns(sourceBlock) ? dist.block(localB, sourceBlock)
+                                               : receivedB.data();
+        MPI_Bcast(bRows, static_cast<int>(sourceRows * dist.n), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  dist.owner(sourceBlock), MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+        for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+            if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+            const double* ownB = dist.block(localB, localBlock);
+            double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+
+            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+                const double* bi = ownB + i * dist.n;
+                double* ai = ownA + i * dist.n;
+                for (size_t j = 0; j < sourceRows; ++j) {
+                    const double* bj = bRows + j * dist.n;
+                    double sum = 0.0;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
+                    for (size_t k = 0; k < dist.n; ++k) {
+                        sum += bi[k] * bj[k];
+                    }
+                    ai[sourceStart + j] = sum;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Add the identity contribution exactly once after all streamed B blocks
+    // have contributed to A = B * B^T.
+    for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+        if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+        const size_t globalStart = dist.firstRow(localBlock);
+        double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+            ownA[i * dist.n + globalStart + i] += static_cast<double>(dist.n);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* block, size_t stride, size_t blockSize,
+                         size_t globalStart, size_t& failedDiagonal) {
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < blockSize; ++j) {
+        double* diagonalRow = block + j * stride;
+        double sum = 0.0;
+        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+            sum += diagonalRow[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+        }
+
+        const double value = diagonalRow[globalStart + j] - sum;
+        if (!(value > 0.0)) {
+            failedDiagonal = globalStart + j;
+            return false;
+        }
+        diagonalRow[globalStart + j] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < blockSize; ++i) {
+            double* row = block + i * stride;
+            double product = 0.0;
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                product += row[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+            }
+            row[globalStart + j] =
+                (row[globalStart + j] - product) / diagonalRow[globalStart + j];
+        }
+    }
+    return true;
+}

-// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)
-// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular
+namespace {

+constexpr size_t kPreferredBlockSize = 32;
+constexpr size_t kMinimumBlockSize = 16;
+constexpr int kDistributionTag = 100;
+constexpr int kGatherTag = 101;
+
+// Matrix row blocks are assigned cyclically.  Unlike a contiguous row
+// decomposition this keeps the increasingly expensive lower rows balanced
+// across ranks throughout the factorization.
+struct RowDistribution {
+    size_t n;
+    size_t blockSize;
+    size_t numBlocks;
+    int rank;
+    int ranks;
+
+    RowDistribution(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRank, int mpiRanks)
+        : n(matrixSize),
+          blockSize(selectBlockSize(matrixSize, mpiRanks)),
+          numBlocks((matrixSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize),
+          rank(mpiRank),
+          ranks(mpiRanks) {}
+
+    static size_t selectBlockSize(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRanks) {
+        if (matrixSize == 0) {
+            return 1;
+        }
+
+        const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(mpiRanks, 1));
+        const size_t targetBlocks = rankCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / 4
+                                        ? std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()
+                                        : 4 * rankCount;
+        const size_t desired = (matrixSize + targetBlocks - 1) / targetBlocks;
+        size_t result = std::min(kPreferredBlockSize,
+                                 std::max(kMinimumBlockSize, desired));
+        result = std::min(result, matrixSize);
+
+        // Do not strand ranks merely because the preferred cache block is
+        // larger than the amount of work available per rank.
+        if ((matrixSize + result - 1) / result < rankCount && matrixSize >= rankCount) {
+            result = (matrixSize + rankCount - 1) / rankCount;
+        }
+        return std::max<size_t>(result, 1);
+    }
+
+    size_t firstRow(size_t block) const { return block * blockSize; }
+
+    size_t rowsInBlock(size_t block) const {
+        return std::min(blockSize, n - firstRow(block));
+    }

+bool mpiCountFits(size_t count) {
+    return count <= static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max());

+
+// Distribute contiguous row blocks without making every process allocate the
+// root's complete matrix.  Messages from a given source use identical tags;
+// MPI's ordering rule matches them to the receives posted in block order.
+void distributeRowsFromRoot(const std::vector<double>& rootMatrix,
+                            std::vector<double>& localMatrix,
+                            const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
+    requests.reserve(dist.numBlocks);
+
+    if (dist.rank == 0) {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+            const double* source = rootMatrix.data() + dist.firstRow(block) * dist.n;
+            if (dist.owner(block) == 0) {
+                std::copy_n(source, count, dist.block(localMatrix, block));
+            } else {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                MPI_Isend(source, static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE, dist.owner(block),
+                          kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    } else {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            if (dist.owns(block)) {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+                MPI_Irecv(dist.block(localMatrix, block), static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          0, kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (!requests.empty()) {
+        MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+    }
+}
+
+// Generate exactly the same deterministic B as the sequential implementation,
+// distribute it, then form only the rows of A owned by this rank.  Each row
+// block of B is streamed once to all ranks, so storage is O(n^2/P).
+void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA,
+                                    const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<double> localB(dist.localRows() * dist.n);
+
+    {
+        std::vector<double> rootB;
+        if (dist.rank == 0) {
+            rootB.resize(dist.n * dist.n);
+            unsigned int seed = 42;
+            for (double& value : rootB) {
+                value = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
+            }
+        }
+        distributeRowsFromRoot(rootB, localB, dist);
+    }
+
+    localA.assign(dist.localRows() * dist.n, 0.0);
+    std::vector<double> receivedB(dist.blockSize * dist.n);
+
+    for (size_t sourceBlock = 0; sourceBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++sourceBlock) {
+        const size_t sourceRows = dist.rowsInBlock(sourceBlock);
+        const size_t sourceStart = dist.firstRow(sourceBlock);
+        double* bRows = dist.owns(sourceBlock) ? dist.block(localB, sourceBlock)
+                                               : receivedB.data();
+        MPI_Bcast(bRows, static_cast<int>(sourceRows * dist.n), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  dist.owner(sourceBlock), MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+        for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+            if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+            const double* ownB = dist.block(localB, localBlock);
+            double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+
+            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+                const double* bi = ownB + i * dist.n;
+                double* ai = ownA + i * dist.n;
+                for (size_t j = 0; j < sourceRows; ++j) {
+                    const double* bj = bRows + j * dist.n;
+                    double sum = 0.0;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
+                    for (size_t k = 0; k < dist.n; ++k) {
+                        sum += bi[k] * bj[k];
+                    }
+                    ai[sourceStart + j] = sum;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Add the identity contribution exactly once after all streamed B blocks
+    // have contributed to A = B * B^T.
+    for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+        if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+        const size_t globalStart = dist.firstRow(localBlock);
+        double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+            ownA[i * dist.n + globalStart + i] += static_cast<double>(dist.n);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* block, size_t stride, size_t blockSize,
+                         size_t globalStart, size_t& failedDiagonal) {
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < blockSize; ++j) {
+        double* diagonalRow = block + j * stride;
+        double sum = 0.0;
+        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+            sum += diagonalRow[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+        }
+
+        const double value = diagonalRow[globalStart + j] - sum;
+        if (!(value > 0.0)) {
+            failedDiagonal = globalStart + j;
+            return false;
+        }
+        diagonalRow[globalStart + j] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < blockSize; ++i) {
+            double* row = block + i * stride;
+            double product = 0.0;
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                product += row[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+            }
+            row[globalStart + j] =
+                (row[globalStart + j] - product) / diagonalRow[globalStart + j];
+        }
+    }
+    return true;
+}
+
+// Blocked right-looking Cholesky.  A compact panel is all-gathered once per
+// block; its per-tile transposed layout makes each trailing rank-k update walk
+// contiguous memory in its innermost loop.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& localA, const RowDistribution& dist,
+                           size_t& failedDiagonal) {
+    std::vector<double> diagonal(dist.blockSize * dist.blockSize);
+    std::vector<int> receiveCounts(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
+    std::vector<int> displacements(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
+    std::vector<size_t> panelOffsets(dist.numBlocks);
+    std::vector<size_t> processOffsets(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
+    std::vector<double> localPanel;
+    std::vector<double> globalPanel;
+
+    for (size_t panelBlock = 0; panelBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++panelBlock) {
+        const size_t panelStart = dist.firstRow(panelBlock);
+        const size_t panelWidth = dist.rowsInBlock(panelBlock);
+        const int diagonalOwner = dist.owner(panelBlock);
+        int success = 1;
+        unsigned long long failed = 0;
+
+        if (dist.rank == diagonalOwner) {
+            size_t localFailure = 0;
+            double* diagonalBlock = dist.block(localA, panelBlock);
+            success = factorDiagonalBlock(diagonalBlock, dist.n, panelWidth,
+                                          panelStart, localFailure)
+                          ? 1
+                          : 0;
+            failed = static_cast<unsigned long long>(localFailure);
+            if (success) {
+                for (size_t i = 0; i < panelWidth; ++i) {
+                    for (size_t j = 0; j < panelWidth; ++j) {
+                        diagonal[i * panelWidth + j] =
+                            j <= i ? diagonalBlock[i * dist.n + panelStart + j] : 0.0;
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        MPI_Bcast(&success, 1, MPI_INT, diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+        if (!success) {
+            failedDiagonal = static_cast<size_t>(failed);
+            return false;
+        }
+        MPI_Bcast(diagonal.data(), static_cast<int>(panelWidth * panelWidth), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+        // Distributed triangular solve for all blocks below the diagonal.
+        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            if (!dist.owns(block)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(block);
+            double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, block);
+            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+                double* row = matrixBlock + i * dist.n + panelStart;

+namespace {
+
+constexpr size_t kPreferredBlockSize = 32;
+constexpr size_t kMinimumBlockSize = 16;
+constexpr int kDistributionTag = 100;
+constexpr int kGatherTag = 101;
+
+// Matrix row blocks are assigned cyclically.  Unlike a contiguous row
+// decomposition this keeps the increasingly expensive lower rows balanced
+// across ranks throughout the factorization.
+struct RowDistribution {
+    size_t n;
+    size_t blockSize;
+    size_t numBlocks;
+    int rank;
+    int ranks;
+
+    RowDistribution(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRank, int mpiRanks)
+        : n(matrixSize),
+          blockSize(selectBlockSize(matrixSize, mpiRanks)),
+          numBlocks((matrixSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize),
+          rank(mpiRank),
+          ranks(mpiRanks) {}
+
+    static size_t selectBlockSize(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRanks) {
+        if (matrixSize == 0) {
+            return 1;
+        }
+
+        const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(mpiRanks, 1));
+        const size_t targetBlocks = rankCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / 4
+                                        ? std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()
+                                        : 4 * rankCount;
+        const size_t desired = (matrixSize + targetBlocks - 1) / targetBlocks;
+        size_t result = std::min(kPreferredBlockSize,
+                                 std::max(kMinimumBlockSize, desired));
+        result = std::min(result, matrixSize);
+
+        // Do not strand ranks merely because the preferred cache block is
+        // larger than the amount of work available per rank.
+        if ((matrixSize + result - 1) / result < rankCount && matrixSize >= rankCount) {
+            result = (matrixSize + rankCount - 1) / rankCount;
+        }
+        return std::max<size_t>(result, 1);
+    }
+
+    size_t firstRow(size_t block) const { return block * blockSize; }
+
+    size_t rowsInBlock(size_t block) const {
+        return std::min(blockSize, n - firstRow(block));
+    }

+    bool owns(size_t block) const { return owner(block) == rank; }

+    size_t localRowOffset(size_t block) const {

+        return (block / static_cast<size_t>(ranks)) * blockSize;

+    size_t localRows(int process) const {

+    }

+    const double* block(const std::vector<double>& matrix, size_t blockIndex) const {
+        return matrix.data() + localRowOffset(blockIndex) * n;
+    }

+bool mpiCountFits(size_t count) {
+    return count <= static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max());

+// Distribute contiguous row blocks without making every process allocate the
+// root's complete matrix.  Messages from a given source use identical tags;
+// MPI's ordering rule matches them to the receives posted in block order.
+void distributeRowsFromRoot(const std::vector<double>& rootMatrix,
+                            std::vector<double>& localMatrix,
+                            const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
+    requests.reserve(dist.numBlocks);
+
+    if (dist.rank == 0) {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+            const double* source = rootMatrix.data() + dist.firstRow(block) * dist.n;
+            if (dist.owner(block) == 0) {
+                std::copy_n(source, count, dist.block(localMatrix, block));
+            } else {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                MPI_Isend(source, static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE, dist.owner(block),
+                          kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    } else {
+        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
+            if (dist.owns(block)) {
+                MPI_Request request;
+                const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
+                MPI_Irecv(dist.block(localMatrix, block), static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                          0, kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
+                requests.push_back(request);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    if (!requests.empty()) {
+        MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
+    }
+}

+// Generate exactly the same deterministic B as the sequential implementation,
+// distribute it, then form only the rows of A owned by this rank.  Each row
+// block of B is streamed once to all ranks, so storage is O(n^2/P).
+void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA,
+                                    const RowDistribution& dist) {
+    std::vector<double> localB(dist.localRows() * dist.n);
+
+    {
+        std::vector<double> rootB;
+        if (dist.rank == 0) {
+            rootB.resize(dist.n * dist.n);
+            unsigned int seed = 42;
+            for (double& value : rootB) {
+                value = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
+            }
+        }
+        distributeRowsFromRoot(rootB, localB, dist);
+    }
+
+    localA.assign(dist.localRows() * dist.n, 0.0);
+    std::vector<double> receivedB(dist.blockSize * dist.n);
+
+    for (size_t sourceBlock = 0; sourceBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++sourceBlock) {
+        const size_t sourceRows = dist.rowsInBlock(sourceBlock);
+        const size_t sourceStart = dist.firstRow(sourceBlock);
+        double* bRows = dist.owns(sourceBlock) ? dist.block(localB, sourceBlock)
+                                               : receivedB.data();
+        MPI_Bcast(bRows, static_cast<int>(sourceRows * dist.n), MPI_DOUBLE,
+                  dist.owner(sourceBlock), MPI_COMM_WORLD);
+
+        for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+            if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+            const double* ownB = dist.block(localB, localBlock);
+            double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+
+            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+                const double* bi = ownB + i * dist.n;
+                double* ai = ownA + i * dist.n;
+                for (size_t j = 0; j < sourceRows; ++j) {
+                    const double* bj = bRows + j * dist.n;
+                    double sum = 0.0;
+#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
+                    for (size_t k = 0; k < dist.n; ++k) {
+                        sum += bi[k] * bj[k];
+                    }
+                    ai[sourceStart + j] = sum;
+                }
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    // Add the identity contribution exactly once after all streamed B blocks
+    // have contributed to A = B * B^T.
+    for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
+        if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
+        const size_t globalStart = dist.firstRow(localBlock);
+        double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
+        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
+            ownA[i * dist.n + globalStart + i] += static_cast<double>(dist.n);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* block, size_t stride, size_t blockSize,
+                         size_t globalStart, size_t& failedDiagonal) {
+    for (size_t j = 0; j < blockSize; ++j) {
+        double* diagonalRow = block + j * stride;
+        double sum = 0.0;
+        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+            sum += diagonalRow[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+        }
+
+        const double value = diagonalRow[globalStart + j] - sum;
+        if (!(value > 0.0)) {
+            failedDiagonal = globalStart + j;
+            return false;
+        }
+        diagonalRow[globalStart + j] = std::sqrt(value);
+
+        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < blockSize; ++i) {
+            double* row = block + i * stride;
+            double product = 0.0;
+            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
+                product += row[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
+            }
+            row[globalStart + j] =
+                (row[globalStart + j] - product) / diagonalRow[globalStart + j];
+        }
+    }
+    return true;
+}

+// Blocked right-looking Cholesky.  A compact panel is all-gathered once per
+// block; its per-tile transposed layout makes each trailing rank-k update walk
+// contiguous memory in its innermost loop.
+bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& localA, const RowDistribution& dist,
+                           size_t& failedDiagonal) {

+    std::vector<size_t> processOffsets(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));

+        const size_t panelStart = dist.firstRow(panelBlock);
+        const size_t panelWidth = dist.rowsInBlock(panelBlock);
+        const int diagonalOwner = dist.owner(panelBlock);
+        int success = 1;
+        unsigned long long failed = 0;
+

+            double* diagonalBlock = dist.block(localA, panelBlock);
+            success = factorDiagonalBlock(diagonalBlock, dist.n, panelWidth,
+                                          panelStart, localFailure)
+                          ? 1
+                          : 0;

+                  diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);

    14	namespace {

    16	constexpr size_t kPreferredBlockSize = 32;
    17	constexpr size_t kMinimumBlockSize = 16;
    18	constexpr int kDistributionTag = 100;
    19	constexpr int kGatherTag = 101;
    20	
    21	// Matrix row blocks are assigned cyclically.  Unlike a contiguous row
    22	// decomposition this keeps the increasingly expensive lower rows balanced
    23	// across ranks throughout the factorization.
    24	struct RowDistribution {
    25	    size_t n;
    26	    size_t blockSize;
    27	    size_t numBlocks;
    28	    int rank;
    29	    int ranks;
    30	
    31	    RowDistribution(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRank, int mpiRanks)
    32	        : n(matrixSize),
    33	          blockSize(selectBlockSize(matrixSize, mpiRanks)),
    34	          numBlocks((matrixSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize),
    35	          rank(mpiRank),
    36	          ranks(mpiRanks) {}
    37	
    38	    static size_t selectBlockSize(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRanks) {
    39	        if (matrixSize == 0) {
    40	            return 1;
    41	        }
    42	
    43	        const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(mpiRanks, 1));
    44	        const size_t targetBlocks = rankCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / 4
    45	                                        ? std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()
    46	                                        : 4 * rankCount;
    47	        const size_t desired = (matrixSize + targetBlocks - 1) / targetBlocks;
    48	        size_t result = std::min(kPreferredBlockSize,
    49	                                 std::max(kMinimumBlockSize, desired));
    50	        result = std::min(result, matrixSize);
    51	
    52	        // Do not strand ranks merely because the preferred cache block is
    53	        // larger than the amount of work available per rank.
    54	        if ((matrixSize + result - 1) / result < rankCount && matrixSize >= rankCount) {
    55	            result = (matrixSize + rankCount - 1) / rankCount;
    56	        }
    57	        return std::max<size_t>(result, 1);
    58	    }
    59	
    60	    size_t firstRow(size_t block) const { return block * blockSize; }
    61	
    62	    size_t rowsInBlock(size_t block) const {
    63	        return std::min(blockSize, n - firstRow(block));
    64	    }
    65	
    66	    int owner(size_t block) const {
    67	        return static_cast<int>(block % static_cast<size_t>(ranks));
    68	    }
    69	
    70	    bool owns(size_t block) const { return owner(block) == rank; }
    71	
    72	    size_t localRowOffset(size_t block) const {
    73	        // Every block preceding the final (possibly short) block is full.
    74	        return (block / static_cast<size_t>(ranks)) * blockSize;
    75	    }
    76	
    77	    size_t localRows(int process) const {
    78	        size_t result = 0;
    79	        for (size_t block = static_cast<size_t>(process); block < numBlocks;
    80	             block += static_cast<size_t>(ranks)) {
    81	            result += rowsInBlock(block);
    82	        }
    83	        return result;
    84	    }
    85	
    86	    size_t localRows() const { return localRows(rank); }
    87	
    88	    double* block(std::vector<double>& matrix, size_t blockIndex) const {
    89	        return matrix.data() + localRowOffset(blockIndex) * n;
    90	    }
    91	
    92	    const double* block(const std::vector<double>& matrix, size_t blockIndex) const {
    93	        return matrix.data() + localRowOffset(blockIndex) * n;
    94	    }
    95	};
    96	
    97	bool mpiCountFits(size_t count) {
    98	    return count <= static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max());
    99	}
   100	
   101	// Distribute contiguous row blocks without making every process allocate the
   102	// root's complete matrix.  Messages from a given source use identical tags;
   103	// MPI's ordering rule matches them to the receives posted in block order.
   104	void distributeRowsFromRoot(const std::vector<double>& rootMatrix,
   105	                            std::vector<double>& localMatrix,
   106	                            const RowDistribution& dist) {
   107	    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
   108	    requests.reserve(dist.numBlocks);
   109	
   110	    if (dist.rank == 0) {
   111	        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   112	            const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
   113	            const double* source = rootMatrix.data() + dist.firstRow(block) * dist.n;
   114	            if (dist.owner(block) == 0) {
   115	                std::copy_n(source, count, dist.block(localMatrix, block));
   116	            } else {
   117	                MPI_Request request;
   118	                MPI_Isend(source, static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE, dist.owner(block),
   119	                          kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
   120	                requests.push_back(request);
   121	            }
   122	        }
   123	    } else {
   124	        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   125	            if (dist.owns(block)) {
   126	                MPI_Request request;
   127	                const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
   128	                MPI_Irecv(dist.block(localMatrix, block), static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE,
   129	                          0, kDistributionTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
   130	                requests.push_back(request);
   131	            }
   132	        }
   133	    }
   134	
   135	    if (!requests.empty()) {
   136	        MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
   137	    }
   138	}
   139	
   140	// Generate exactly the same deterministic B as the sequential implementation,
   141	// distribute it, then form only the rows of A owned by this rank.  Each row
   142	// block of B is streamed once to all ranks, so storage is O(n^2/P).
   143	void generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA,
   144	                                    const RowDistribution& dist) {
   145	    std::vector<double> localB(dist.localRows() * dist.n);
   146	
   147	    {
   148	        std::vector<double> rootB;
   149	        if (dist.rank == 0) {
   150	            rootB.resize(dist.n * dist.n);
   151	            unsigned int seed = 42;
   152	            for (double& value : rootB) {
   153	                value = (rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX)) - 0.5;
   154	            }
   155	        }
   156	        distributeRowsFromRoot(rootB, localB, dist);
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    localA.assign(dist.localRows() * dist.n, 0.0);
   160	    std::vector<double> receivedB(dist.blockSize * dist.n);
   161	
   162	    for (size_t sourceBlock = 0; sourceBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++sourceBlock) {
   163	        const size_t sourceRows = dist.rowsInBlock(sourceBlock);
   164	        const size_t sourceStart = dist.firstRow(sourceBlock);
   165	        double* bRows = dist.owns(sourceBlock) ? dist.block(localB, sourceBlock)
   166	                                               : receivedB.data();
   167	        MPI_Bcast(bRows, static_cast<int>(sourceRows * dist.n), MPI_DOUBLE,
   168	                  dist.owner(sourceBlock), MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   169	
   170	        for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
   171	            if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
   172	                continue;
   173	            }
   174	            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
   175	            const double* ownB = dist.block(localB, localBlock);
   176	            double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
   177	
   178	            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
   179	                const double* bi = ownB + i * dist.n;
   180	                double* ai = ownA + i * dist.n;
   181	                for (size_t j = 0; j < sourceRows; ++j) {
   182	                    const double* bj = bRows + j * dist.n;
   183	                    double sum = 0.0;
   184	#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
   185	                    for (size_t k = 0; k < dist.n; ++k) {
   186	                        sum += bi[k] * bj[k];
   187	                    }
   188	                    ai[sourceStart + j] = sum;
   189	                }
   190	            }
   191	        }
   192	    }
   193	
   194	    // Add the identity contribution exactly once after all streamed B blocks
   195	    // have contributed to A = B * B^T.
   196	    for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
   197	        if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
   198	            continue;
   199	        }
   200	        const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
   201	        const size_t globalStart = dist.firstRow(localBlock);
   202	        double* ownA = dist.block(localA, localBlock);
   203	        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
   204	            ownA[i * dist.n + globalStart + i] += static_cast<double>(dist.n);
   205	        }
   206	    }
   207	}
   208	
   209	bool factorDiagonalBlock(double* block, size_t stride, size_t blockSize,
   210	                         size_t globalStart, size_t& failedDiagonal) {
   211	    for (size_t j = 0; j < blockSize; ++j) {
   212	        double* diagonalRow = block + j * stride;
   213	        double sum = 0.0;
   214	        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
   215	            sum += diagonalRow[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
   216	        }
   217	
   218	        const double value = diagonalRow[globalStart + j] - sum;
   219	        if (!(value > 0.0)) {
   220	            failedDiagonal = globalStart + j;
   220	            failedDiagonal = globalStart + j;
   221	            return false;
   222	        }
   223	        diagonalRow[globalStart + j] = std::sqrt(value);
   224	
   225	        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < blockSize; ++i) {
   226	            double* row = block + i * stride;
   227	            double product = 0.0;
   228	            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
   229	                product += row[globalStart + k] * diagonalRow[globalStart + k];
   230	            }
   231	            row[globalStart + j] =
   232	                (row[globalStart + j] - product) / diagonalRow[globalStart + j];
   233	        }
   234	    }
   235	    return true;
   236	}
   237	
   238	// Blocked right-looking Cholesky.  A compact panel is all-gathered once per
   239	// block; its per-tile transposed layout makes each trailing rank-k update walk
   240	// contiguous memory in its innermost loop.
   241	bool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& localA, const RowDistribution& dist,
   242	                           size_t& failedDiagonal) {
   243	    std::vector<double> diagonal(dist.blockSize * dist.blockSize);
   244	    std::vector<int> receiveCounts(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
   245	    std::vector<int> displacements(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
   246	    std::vector<size_t> panelOffsets(dist.numBlocks);
   247	    std::vector<size_t> processOffsets(static_cast<size_t>(dist.ranks));
   248	    std::vector<double> localPanel;
   249	    std::vector<double> globalPanel;
   250	
   251	    for (size_t panelBlock = 0; panelBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++panelBlock) {
   252	        const size_t panelStart = dist.firstRow(panelBlock);
   253	        const size_t panelWidth = dist.rowsInBlock(panelBlock);
   254	        const int diagonalOwner = dist.owner(panelBlock);
   255	        int success = 1;
   256	        unsigned long long failed = 0;
   257	
   258	        if (dist.rank == diagonalOwner) {
   259	            size_t localFailure = 0;
   260	            double* diagonalBlock = dist.block(localA, panelBlock);
   261	            success = factorDiagonalBlock(diagonalBlock, dist.n, panelWidth,
   262	                                          panelStart, localFailure)
   263	                          ? 1
   264	                          : 0;
   265	            failed = static_cast<unsigned long long>(localFailure);
   266	            if (success) {
   267	                for (size_t i = 0; i < panelWidth; ++i) {
   268	                    for (size_t j = 0; j < panelWidth; ++j) {
   269	                        diagonal[i * panelWidth + j] =
   270	                            j <= i ? diagonalBlock[i * dist.n + panelStart + j] : 0.0;
   271	                    }
   272	                }
   273	            }
   274	        }
   275	
   276	        MPI_Bcast(&success, 1, MPI_INT, diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   277	        MPI_Bcast(&failed, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   278	        if (!success) {
   279	            failedDiagonal = static_cast<size_t>(failed);
   280	            return false;
   281	        }
   282	        MPI_Bcast(diagonal.data(), static_cast<int>(panelWidth * panelWidth), MPI_DOUBLE,
   283	                  diagonalOwner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   284	
   285	        // Distributed triangular solve for all blocks below the diagonal.
   286	        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   287	            if (!dist.owns(block)) {
   288	                continue;
   289	            }
   290	            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(block);
   291	            double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, block);
   292	            for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
   293	                double* row = matrixBlock + i * dist.n + panelStart;
   294	                for (size_t j = 0; j < panelWidth; ++j) {
   295	                    double product = 0.0;
   296	                    for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {
   297	                        product += row[k] * diagonal[j * panelWidth + k];
   298	                    }
   299	                    row[j] = (row[j] - product) / diagonal[j * panelWidth + j];
   300	                }
   301	            }
   302	        }
   303	
   304	        std::fill(receiveCounts.begin(), receiveCounts.end(), 0);
   305	        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   306	            receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(dist.owner(block))] +=
   307	                static_cast<int>(dist.rowsInBlock(block) * panelWidth);
   308	        }
   309	        int totalPanelValues = 0;
   310	        for (int process = 0; process < dist.ranks; ++process) {
   311	            displacements[static_cast<size_t>(process)] = totalPanelValues;
   312	            totalPanelValues += receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(process)];
   313	        }
   314	
   315	        localPanel.resize(
   316	            static_cast<size_t>(receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(dist.rank)]));
   317	        size_t packedOffset = 0;
   318	        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   319	            if (!dist.owns(block)) {
   320	                continue;
   321	            }
   322	            const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(block);
   323	            const double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, block);
   324	            // Transpose the narrow panel tile while packing it.
   325	            for (size_t k = 0; k < panelWidth; ++k) {
   326	                for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
   327	                    localPanel[packedOffset++] = matrixBlock[i * dist.n + panelStart + k];
   328	                }
   329	            }
   330	        }
   331	
   332	        globalPanel.resize(static_cast<size_t>(totalPanelValues));
   333	        MPI_Allgatherv(localPanel.data(),
   334	                       receiveCounts[static_cast<size_t>(dist.rank)], MPI_DOUBLE,
   335	                       globalPanel.data(), receiveCounts.data(), displacements.data(),
   336	                       MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   337	
   338	        for (int process = 0; process < dist.ranks; ++process) {
   339	            processOffsets[static_cast<size_t>(process)] =
   340	                static_cast<size_t>(displacements[static_cast<size_t>(process)]);
   341	        }
   342	        for (size_t block = panelBlock + 1; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   343	            const size_t owner = static_cast<size_t>(dist.owner(block));
   344	            panelOffsets[block] = processOffsets[owner];
   345	            processOffsets[owner] += dist.rowsInBlock(block) * panelWidth;
   346	        }
   347	
   348	        // Each rank updates all lower-triangular tiles in its owned block rows.
   349	        for (size_t rowBlock = panelBlock + 1; rowBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++rowBlock) {
   350	            if (!dist.owns(rowBlock)) {
   351	                continue;
   352	            }
   353	            const size_t rowCount = dist.rowsInBlock(rowBlock);
   354	            const size_t rowStart = dist.firstRow(rowBlock);
   355	            double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, rowBlock);
   356	            const double* leftPanel = globalPanel.data() + panelOffsets[rowBlock];
   357	
   358	            for (size_t columnBlock = panelBlock + 1; columnBlock <= rowBlock;
   359	                 ++columnBlock) {
   360	                const size_t columnCount = dist.rowsInBlock(columnBlock);
   361	                const size_t columnStart = dist.firstRow(columnBlock);
   362	                const double* rightPanel = globalPanel.data() + panelOffsets[columnBlock];
   363	
   364	                if (columnBlock < rowBlock) {
   365	                    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount; ++i) {
   366	                        double* result = matrixBlock + i * dist.n + columnStart;
   367	                        for (size_t k = 0; k < panelWidth; ++k) {
   368	                            const double multiplier = leftPanel[k * rowCount + i];
   369	                            const double* rhs = rightPanel + k * columnCount;
   370	#pragma omp simd
   371	                            for (size_t j = 0; j < columnCount; ++j) {
   372	                                result[j] -= multiplier * rhs[j];
   373	                            }
   374	                        }
   375	                    }
   376	                } else {
   377	                    // Only the lower half of a diagonal tile is subsequently used.
   378	                    for (size_t i = 0; i < rowCount; ++i) {
   379	                        double* result = matrixBlock + i * dist.n + rowStart;
   380	                        for (size_t k = 0; k < panelWidth; ++k) {
   381	                            const double multiplier = leftPanel[k * rowCount + i];
   382	                            const double* rhs = leftPanel + k * rowCount;
   383	#pragma omp simd
   384	                            for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
   385	                                result[j] -= multiplier * rhs[j];
   386	                            }
   387	                        }
   388	                    }
   389	                }
   390	            }
   391	        }
   392	    }
   393	
   394	    // Match the original result representation: L occupies the lower triangle
   395	    // and every element above it is zero.
   396	    for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   397	        if (!dist.owns(block)) {
   398	            continue;
   399	        }
   400	        const size_t rows = dist.rowsInBlock(block);
   401	        const size_t start = dist.firstRow(block);
   402	        double* matrixBlock = dist.block(localA, block);
   403	        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
   404	            double* row = matrixBlock + i * dist.n;
   405	            std::fill(row + start + i + 1, row + dist.n, 0.0);
   406	        }
   407	    }
   408	    return true;
   409	}
   410	
   411	bool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& localL,
   412	                      const std::vector<double>& localOriginal,
   413	                      const RowDistribution& dist) {
   414	    std::vector<double> receivedRows(dist.blockSize * dist.n);
   415	    double localMaxAbsolute = 0.0;
   416	    double localMaxRelative = 0.0;
   417	
   418	    for (size_t sourceBlock = 0; sourceBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++sourceBlock) {
   419	        const size_t sourceRows = dist.rowsInBlock(sourceBlock);
   420	        const size_t sourceStart = dist.firstRow(sourceBlock);
   421	        double* source = dist.owns(sourceBlock)
   422	                             ? const_cast<double*>(dist.block(localL, sourceBlock))
   423	                             : receivedRows.data();
   424	        MPI_Bcast(source, static_cast<int>(sourceRows * dist.n), MPI_DOUBLE,
   425	                  dist.owner(sourceBlock), MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   426	
   427	        for (size_t localBlock = 0; localBlock < dist.numBlocks; ++localBlock) {
   428	            if (!dist.owns(localBlock)) {
   429	                continue;
   430	            }
   431	            const size_t localRows = dist.rowsInBlock(localBlock);
   432	            const double* lRows = dist.block(localL, localBlock);
   433	            const double* originalRows = dist.block(localOriginal, localBlock);
   434	            for (size_t i = 0; i < localRows; ++i) {
   435	                const double* li = lRows + i * dist.n;
   436	                const double* original = originalRows + i * dist.n;
   437	                for (size_t j = 0; j < sourceRows; ++j) {
   438	                    const double* lj = source + j * dist.n;
   439	                    double sum = 0.0;
   440	                    const size_t terms = std::min(dist.firstRow(localBlock) + i,
   441	                                                  sourceStart + j) +
   442	                                         1;
   443	#pragma omp simd reduction(+ : sum)
   444	                    for (size_t k = 0; k < terms; ++k) {
   445	                        sum += li[k] * lj[k];
   446	                    }
   447	                    const double error = std::fabs(sum - original[sourceStart + j]);
   448	                    const double relative =
   449	                        error / (std::fabs(original[sourceStart + j]) + 1e-10);
   450	                    localMaxAbsolute = std::max(localMaxAbsolute, error);
   451	                    localMaxRelative = std::max(localMaxRelative, relative);
   452	                }
   453	            }
   454	        }
   455	    }
   456	
   457	    double localErrors[2] = {localMaxAbsolute, localMaxRelative};
   458	    double globalErrors[2] = {0.0, 0.0};
   459	    MPI_Allreduce(localErrors, globalErrors, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   460	
   460	
   461	    if (dist.rank == 0) {
   462	        std::printf("Max absolute error: %.10e\n", globalErrors[0]);
   463	        std::printf("Max relative error: %.10e\n", globalErrors[1]);
   464	        if (globalErrors[1] > 1e-6) {
   465	            std::printf("Validation failed: relative error too large\n");
   466	        }
   467	    }
   468	    return globalErrors[1] <= 1e-6;
   469	}
   470	
   471	std::vector<double> gatherRowsToRoot(const std::vector<double>& localMatrix,
   472	                                     const RowDistribution& dist) {
   473	    std::vector<double> globalMatrix;
   474	    if (dist.rank == 0) {
   475	        globalMatrix.resize(dist.n * dist.n);
   476	    }
   477	
   478	    std::vector<MPI_Request> requests;
   479	    requests.reserve(dist.numBlocks);
   480	    if (dist.rank == 0) {
   481	        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   482	            const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
   483	            double* destination = globalMatrix.data() + dist.firstRow(block) * dist.n;
   484	            if (dist.owner(block) == 0) {
   485	                std::copy_n(dist.block(localMatrix, block), count, destination);
   486	            } else {
   487	                MPI_Request request;
   488	                MPI_Irecv(destination, static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE,
   489	                          dist.owner(block), kGatherTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
   490	                requests.push_back(request);
   491	            }
   492	        }
   493	    } else {
   494	        for (size_t block = 0; block < dist.numBlocks; ++block) {
   495	            if (dist.owns(block)) {
   496	                MPI_Request request;
   497	                const size_t count = dist.rowsInBlock(block) * dist.n;
   498	                MPI_Isend(dist.block(localMatrix, block), static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE,
   499	                          0, kGatherTag, MPI_COMM_WORLD, &request);
   500	                requests.push_back(request);
   501	            }
   502	        }
   503	    }
   504	
   505	    if (!requests.empty()) {
   506	        MPI_Waitall(static_cast<int>(requests.size()), requests.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);
   507	    }
   508	    return globalMatrix;
   509	}

   511	void printUsage(const char* programName) {
   512	    std::printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", programName);
   513	    std::printf("Options:\n");
   514	    std::printf("  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\n");
   515	    std::printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   516	    std::printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
   517	    std::printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   518	}

   522	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   523	    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);
   524	    MPI_Comm_set_errhandler(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_ERRORS_ARE_FATAL);
   525	
   526	    int rank = 0;
   527	    int ranks = 1;
   528	    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
   529	    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks);
   530	
   531	    size_t n = 512;
   532	    bool validate = false;
   533	    bool printResults = false;
   534	    bool showHelp = false;
   535	    bool argumentsValid = true;
   536	
   537	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   538	        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   539	            errno = 0;
   540	            char* end = nullptr;
   541	            const unsigned long long parsed = std::strtoull(argv[++i], &end, 10);
   542	            if (errno != 0 || end == argv[i] || *end != '\0' || parsed == 0 ||
   543	                parsed > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()) {
   544	                argumentsValid = false;
   545	            } else {
   546	                n = static_cast<size_t>(parsed);
   547	            }
   548	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   549	            validate = true;
   550	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
   551	            printResults = true;
   552	        } else if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   553	            showHelp = true;
   554	        } else {
   555	            if (rank == 0) {
   556	                std::printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   557	            }
   558	            argumentsValid = false;
   559	        }
   560	    }
   561	
   562	    if (showHelp || !argumentsValid) {
   563	        if (rank == 0) {
   564	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   565	        }
   566	        MPI_Finalize();
   567	        return argumentsValid ? 0 : 1;
   568	    }
   569	
   570	    const RowDistribution dist(n, rank, ranks);
   571	    const bool dimensionsFit =
   572	        n <= std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / n &&
   573	        mpiCountFits(dist.blockSize * n) && mpiCountFits(n * dist.blockSize);
   574	    if (!dimensionsFit) {
   575	        if (rank == 0) {
   576	            std::printf("Error: matrix is too large for this MPI implementation\n");
   577	        }
   578	        MPI_Finalize();
   579	        return 1;
   580	    }
   581	
   582	    if (rank == 0) {
   583	        std::printf("Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\n");
   584	        std::printf("Matrix size: %zu x %zu\n", n, n);
   585	        std::printf("MPI ranks: %d\n", ranks);
   586	        std::printf("Block size: %zu\n", dist.blockSize);
   587	        std::printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   588	        std::printf("Generating positive definite matrix...\n");
   589	    }
   590	
   591	    std::vector<double> localA;
   592	    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(localA, dist);
   593	    std::vector<double> localOriginal;
   594	    if (validate) {
   595	        localOriginal = localA;
   596	    }
   597	
   598	    if (rank == 0) {
   599	        std::printf("Computing Cholesky decomposition...\n");
   600	    }
   601	    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   602	    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
   603	    size_t failedDiagonal = 0;
   604	    const bool success = choleskyDecomposition(localA, dist, failedDiagonal);
   605	    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
   606	    double elapsed = 0.0;
   607	    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);
   608	
   609	    if (!success) {
   610	        if (rank == 0) {
   611	            std::printf("Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\n",
   612	                        failedDiagonal);
   613	            std::printf("Cholesky decomposition failed\n");
   614	        }
   615	        MPI_Finalize();
   616	        return 1;
   617	    }
   618	
   619	    if (rank == 0) {
   620	        std::printf("Computation time: %.3f ms\n", elapsed * 1000.0);
   621	        const double operations = static_cast<double>(n) * static_cast<double>(n) *
   622	                                  static_cast<double>(n) / 3.0;
   623	        const double gflops = elapsed > 0.0 ? operations / elapsed / 1e9 : 0.0;
   624	        std::printf("Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\n", gflops);
   625	    }
   626	
   627	    if (printResults) {
   628	        std::vector<double> globalA = gatherRowsToRoot(localA, dist);
   629	        if (rank == 0) {
   630	            print_results(globalA, "CholeskyL");
   631	        }
   632	    }
   633	
   634	    int returnCode = 0;
   635	    if (validate) {
   636	        if (rank == 0) {
   637	            std::printf("Validating result...\n");
   638	        }
   639	        const bool valid = validateCholesky(localA, localOriginal, dist);
   640	        if (rank == 0) {
   641	            std::printf("Validation: %s\n", valid ? "PASSED" : "FAILED");
   642	        }
   643	        returnCode = valid ? 0 : 1;
   644	    }
   645	
   646	    MPI_Finalize();
   647	    return returnCode;
   648	}

+constexpr size_t kPreferredBlockSize = 32;
+constexpr size_t kMinimumBlockSize = 16;
+constexpr int kDistributionTag = 100;
+constexpr int kGatherTag = 101;
+
+// Matrix row blocks are assigned cyclically.  Unlike a contiguous row
+// decomposition this keeps the increasingly expensive lower rows balanced
+// across ranks throughout the factorization.
+struct RowDistribution {
+    size_t n;
+    size_t blockSize;
+    size_t numBlocks;
+    int rank;
+    int ranks;
+
+    RowDistribution(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRank, int mpiRanks)
+        : n(matrixSize),
+          blockSize(selectBlockSize(matrixSize, mpiRanks)),
+          numBlocks((matrixSize + blockSize - 1) / blockSize),
+          rank(mpiRank),
+          ranks(mpiRanks) {}
+
+    static size_t selectBlockSize(size_t matrixSize, int mpiRanks) {
+        if (matrixSize == 0) {
+            return 1;
+        }
+
+        const size_t rankCount = static_cast<size_t>(std::max(mpiRanks, 1));
+        const size_t targetBlocks = rankCount > std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max() / 4
+                                        ? std::numeric_limits<size_t>::max()
+                                        : 4 * rankCount;
+        const size_t desired = (matrixSize + targetBlocks - 1) / targetBlocks;
+        size_t result = std::min(kPreferredBlockSize,
+                                 std::max(kMinimumBlockSize, desired));
+        result = std::min(result, matrixSize);
+
+        // Do not strand ranks merely because the preferred cache block is
+        // larger than the amount of work available per rank.
+        if ((matrixSize + result - 1) / result < rankCount && matrixSize >= rankCount) {
+            result = (matrixSize + rankCount - 1) / rankCount;
+        }
+        return std::max<size_t>(result, 1);
+    }
+
+    size_t firstRow(size_t block) const { return block * blockSize; }
+
+    size_t rowsInBlock(size_t block) const {
+        return std::min(blockSize, n - firstRow(block));
+    }

+bool mpiCountFits(size_t count) {
+    return count <= static_cast<size_t>(std::numeric_limits<int>::max());
